style_prefix: Crisp 16-bit SNES/Celeste retro indie game pixel art, bold clean dark outlines, flat vibrant cel-shaded pixel colors, NO anti-aliasing, NO gradients, NO blur, NO text labels, strictly isolated objects on an evenly spaced grid.

A 4 columns by 2 rows sprite sheet grid (8 evenly spaced isolated 16-bit pixel art sprites with generous transparent padding, no grid lines drawn): Row 1 (Zo, cute cartoon young man with spiky reddish-brown hair, sky-blue t-shirt, grey-blue pants, white sneakers): (1) Zo standing idle facing right, (2) Zo running pose, (3) Zo trapped floating inside a dark-blue glass liquid containment pod with glowing cables attached, (4) Zo translucent cyan-white glowing ghost silhouette pointing forward to guide a path.
